title: Reptiles: name the family
intro: Name the taxonomic family of each animal (reptiles).

questions.prompt: To which family does the common house gecko (Hemidactylus frenatus) belong?
questions.explain: The common house gecko (Hemidactylus frenatus) belongs to the family gecko, order Squamata.

questions.prompt: To which family does the Veiled chameleon (Chamaeleo calyptratus) belong?
questions.explain: The Veiled chameleon (Chamaeleo calyptratus) belongs to the family chameleon, order Squamata.

questions.prompt: To which family does the Plumed basilisk (Basiliscus plumifrons) belong?
questions.explain: The Plumed basilisk (Basiliscus plumifrons) belongs to the family Corytophanidae, order Squamata.

questions.prompt: To which family does the freshwater crocodile (Crocodylus johnsoni) belong?
questions.explain: The freshwater crocodile (Crocodylus johnsoni) belongs to the family Crocodile, order Crocodilia.

questions.prompt: To which family does the Rainbow boa (Epicrates cenchria) belong?
questions.explain: The Rainbow boa (Epicrates cenchria) belongs to the family Boidae, order Squamata.

questions.prompt: To which family does the common snapping turtle (Chelydra serpentina) belong?
questions.explain: The common snapping turtle (Chelydra serpentina) belongs to the family Chelydridae, order Testudines.

questions.prompt: To which family does the Iberian worm lizard (Blanus cinereus) belong?
questions.explain: The Iberian worm lizard (Blanus cinereus) belongs to the family Blanidae, order Squamata.

questions.prompt: To which family does the flying snake (Chrysopelea ornata) belong?
questions.explain: The flying snake (Chrysopelea ornata) belongs to the family Colubridae, order Squamata.

questions.prompt: To which family does the Chinese crocodile lizard (Shinisaurus crocodilurus) belong?
questions.explain: The Chinese crocodile lizard (Shinisaurus crocodilurus) belongs to the family Shinisauridae, order Squamata.

questions.prompt: To which family does the Galapagos land iguana (Conolophus subcristatus) belong?
questions.explain: The Galapagos land iguana (Conolophus subcristatus) belongs to the family Iguanidae, order Squamata.
